notes.title: MEGA Devlog
notes.notes:
[p]There have been no updates on the progress of Princess Hunter for a long time. Many of you have been asking what's happening with the game, and some have unsubscribed because they've grown tired of waiting. I had planned to release another devlog back in May, but the plan never came about. However, those who ask shall receive, those who wait shall be rewarded and those who rock shall roll. Today, the most patient among you will finally find out what's going on with PH right now and what to expect in the future. Make yourself comfortable and prepare for an honest account of the ins and outs of game development, with all the intimate details you won't find in other devlogs![/p][h2]Silent Mode[/h2][p]Our PH social media pages have been inactive since late spring, which has understandably caused concern among our subscribers. There have been no new posts about our progress, no new characters or game lore and no comic strips… Dang it, even regular reposts of works by our dedicated fan artists have stopped! Could it be that Princess Hunter joined the ranks of abandonware that will never see the light of day?..[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/25358f48051e7dd1db420472ecfaeabf08bfe4a2.png"][/img][/p][p]No way! On the contrary, we have scaled back our public activity to the bare minimum in order to focus entirely on finishing a playable demo. Earlier on, when the artwork and game design were much further along than the coding, we had time for comics and social media. Now that our programmer can work on Princess Hunter full time however, this part has been gaining momentum. The downside is that until the demo is released, all our resources will be focused on development. Our team is small, and this project is a labor of love, so it requires all the effort, time and money we have. In the future, we'll try to strike a balance between working on the project and interacting with the community, like providing regular updates. For now, we hope for your support and understanding.[/p][p]Another reason for our digital silence, during which there were no reposts of fan art even, is that we have been constantly on the move. Due to the vagaries of life, the writer of the game and this devlog has had to spend a lot of time on the road. Often, without any internet access. However, the most active period of travel is behind us. That means, I'll start catching up on everything our staunch followers have been creating during this time. In fact, I'd like to express my HUGE gratitude to everyone who creates fan art for PH. Thanks to you, our entire team stays motivated to continue working on the project. Thanks to you, others can learn about our pretty monstergirls. You're great![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/34f248eb707dba7ca981aa46913a3fe9c3dc71f1.png"][/img][/p][h2]Global Changes[/h2][p]After conducting some closed playtests and analyzing their results, we concluded that one of the game's core mechanics requires a complete overhaul. That mechanic is exploration, specifically how the player moves around the game world.[/p][p]As you may remember, the initial idea was as follows: Each level consisted of a number of "clearings" that were connected by paths for the Gunslinger to traverse. In each clearing, he could encounter enemy mobs or find useful items, interactive objects, and so on. Although there were no movement points, this node-based concept made the game appear turn-based.[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/D9HByS8.gif"][/img][/p][p]There are no good or bad mechanics in the abstract; each one must be considered in the context of the actual game along with all its other mechanics and factors. In the case of Princess Hunter, the node-based movement just proved to be the wrong choice.[/p][p]First, the discrete movement slowed down the game's pace. Although this feature was intended to provide contrast with the actual turn-based combat, it actually felt even slower.[/p][p]Second, this mechanic limited the player's freedom and prevented the implementation of secret nooks and crannies. Although the game itself was not linear, and the Gunslinger could return to the clearings he had visited earlier and take a different route, progress felt railroaded.[/p][p]Third, the combination of this movement model (the so-called [i]legacy map[/i]) and turn-based card battles created the wrong expectations when we showed early screenshots to people. Most of them thought our game was yet another card roguelike similar to Slay the Spire. So many StS clones have been released in recent years that players have developed a stereotype. Seeing the two mechanics side by side, players have grown to expect short gaming sessions comprised of discrete runs. And because Princess Hunter is in fact a story-heavy RPG coupled with a dating sim, such players would have been very disappointed.[/p][p]And although we put a lot of effort into making the clearings, we unanimously decided to discard that idea in favor of free movement around large open-world locations, Zelda-style. The 2.5D perspective and the level art won't change significantly. Basically, instead of moving from one clearing to another along predetermined paths, the Gunslinger will be able to walk around in any direction. Mobs will become more MOBile and will sometimes attack the player… and some of them will even have to be chased down! Thanks to many new interaction mechanics, level exploration will be at least 20% cooler.[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/PeVz11Y.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/23df972aea3762c423c4b8586d91c9adc814dcce.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/a95ee9ac7f69d27b40c4931d7b094d7829483072.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And these are not just abstract reflections. In fact, many of the things I just described have already been implemented! The first rough tests have shown that this is the right direction. Right now we're working on a large open-world level that you'll see in the demo. Building this level takes more time  compared to older, smaller ones, but we're not scrapping the previous groundwork. Everything that has been done will be incorporated into the new location. [/p][h2]Failures and Setbacks[/h2][p]I don't want to dazzle you with all these innovations and make you believe that the project is nearing completion at full speed and that everything we do is a complete success. As with any artistic endeavor, developing a game involves many experiments, but not all of them are successful or at least bring the project closer to release. Developing a game is always a search. For approaches. For solutions. For people, even.[/p][p]I've long dreamed of including visually impressive cutscenes in the game. And when fate brought me together with a novice yet promising stop-motion artist, I knew I couldn't pass up the opportunity.[/p][p]Unfortunately, as soon as we shook hands, that talented animator started experiencing one misfortune after another: evading the draft, moving homes, blackouts, and health issues. I'm not superstitious, but I decided that it would be better to end our collaboration, out of fear of causing a tsunami or earthquake that would harm many innocent people. After this short-lived experiment, all that remains is a hole in our budget and a couple of rough GIF animations.[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/LGzKc2e.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/6e18c0343c64f0e2e0351a23fee2e2dba6d7ebe5.gif"][/img]
[/p][p]There will definitely be cool cutscenes someday, as soon as we find an animator, or animators, who isn't (so) cursed![/p][p]However, after years of daily efforts put into the project, even the most determined and tested members of the developing team (basically, its backbone) can burn out and lose enthusiasm. It can be hard to wait for the release of your favorite game (hello, Silksong!), but imagine the feeling when you are [i]making[/i] your favorite game, day after day… only to open the comments section and see messages like "What's taking so long?" or "Are them devs even planning on delivering the game?". Before posting something like that, ask yourselves: What exactly do you want to achieve? If your aim is to hurt the developer and kill yet another spark of motivation in him, then by all means do post it! That works great, even if you get no reply. If, on the other hand, you want to encourage the developers, then comments like "It's been a while, but I still believe in you and I'm looking forward to playing the game! Thank you for all your efforts!" would be a better option.[/p][p]Don't worry, our core team is still the same. We have rested and are ready to dive back into the development routine with renewed vigor. Hopefully, that will be enough so that you can all eventually enjoy Princess Hunter![/p][h2]Investment and Finances[/h2][p]Developing a large-scale project like PH requires a lot of resources. Even with regular cutting of various features, such as certain mechanics, plot arcs and content, it's impossible to make a good enough game if one only has free time to work on it. Currently, only the game's writer/team lead/narrative designer and lead artist can do it full time, and recently, like I mentioned above, the programmer has joined us as well. Other than that, we have to rely on outsourced animators, composers, artists, and marketing specialists. We have to pay for everything ourselves because we sincerely love and believe in our project. However, one doesn't have to be a development genius to understand that we would finish the work much faster if we could expand our team and avoid getting sidetracked by odd jobs. That's why I regularly reach out to publishers to raise investments.[/p][p]The sad truth is that, with over 60k wishlists but no solid demo, our prospects in negotiations with investors and publishers are extremely weak. The Covid days of being able to secure large sums of money having nothing but a snazzy pitch are long gone. Today you need much, much more than that before they will even consider speaking with you. And to obtain remotely acceptable terms, you must have not just an ace up your sleeve, but a whole deck of trumps.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/8bcd841d2c16e27be4ffd0ae789752ea7ad0db67.png"][/img][/p][p]Some time ago, PH caught the attention of a major investor. After several meetings to discuss the budget and project roadmap, we agreed on a sum that would enable us to complete the game within a year. It seemed like a long-awaited victory, but in the end, I rejected that generous offer. It wasn't an easy decision, but I found the proposed terms to be unacceptable. The publisher's percentage was high, but manageable. The problem was that they were also asking for the rights to the entire Princess Hunter franchise, as well as a stake in our company. To me, PH is more than just a game and I cherish ambitious plans to develop this universe; that's why I see any outside interference as an attack on my personal boundaries. Besides, I know too many sad stories from the gaming industry about creators being deprived of the rights to their own creations, from Jon Van Caneghem of Might & Magic fame to Robert Kurvitz, who was swindled out of Disco Elisium. Therefore, I have decided that I would rather spend several more years making the game or look for more favorable terms once we have a working demo. What I don't want is to visit some gaming store one day and see a Princess Hunter Odyssey 7, which I had nothing to do with.[/p][h2]Bottom Line[/h2][p]It was a long read, but it's also been a while since our last devlog. Nevertheless, I provided you with an unadulterated account of how things are going. And from my perspective, they are going quite well.[/p][p]To sum up:[/p][list][*][p]The project is still on.[/p][/*][*][p]The game will have an open world with free movement.[/p][/*][*][p]Being an animator is tough.[/p][/*][*][p]We were offered to sell out, but we chose to stay poor and free instead.
[/p][/*][/list][p]If you like PH, stay with us. After all, we're making it exactly for people like you ;)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/88053dd4dbb3ef99c054f7228ea875e312f3e377.png"][/img][/p]

Today, all the worlds of Princess Hunter are celebrating a music festival! This event in honor of the birthday of our composer, the magnificent and incomparable [b]Kate Yantser[/b]! Her music and magical voice will help you immerse yourself in the atmosphere of adventure and amazing wanderings. On behalf of the whole team, we congratulate Kate and look forward to hearing more of her marvelous works. Please join us in congratulating her - she will be very pleased!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/09ad0ef2d1bd0ae6e3f45730dc3001a59a54ecf2.png[/img]

The second important reason for celebration is that thanks to the efforts of programmers, wonderful music and many sounds are now not just lying in folders, but added to the game! We are one step closer to release.

notes.title: Devlog #10
notes.notes:
Every game needs a set of core gameplay rules embodied in code. But in some cases, it is necessary to break these rules, for example, to make a quest more interesting, to add a plot twist, or to display a cutscene.

To keep the game system from collapsing like a house of cards because of such interventions, it must be “broken” carefully and expertly. When done well, such extra mechanics become a useful mechanism rather than a buggy workaround that is not only safe to use in normal situations, but also provides new tools to bring other ideas to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/e50f0bd5c7acd1b0697a84bf4afaa287dac12d85.gif[/img]

Normally, new areas (in Wyrdwood, they are represented by clearings) open up as soon as the Gunslinger gets close to them. But now we've implemented hidden areas and secret paths! The player will be able to find them by completing quests, learning about them by talking to other characters, or by finding a map.

notes.title: Devlog #9
notes.notes:
Let's face it: We all hate tutorials. Players hate going through them; developers hate making them. But experience shows that if the game is good, players won't complain too much after even the most annoying tutorial. But if the game is complicated and has no tutorial, players are very likely to give up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/f4b7f9735ca9a937698b1fdfc45bbf609bd81a60.png[/img]

That's why, even in the demo version, we're taking our time to create a simplified and brief tutorial for all the basic mechanics. For now, it consists of pop-up windows and tooltips, but in the full version of the game, we plan to seriously rework the tutorial and integrate it into the game as organically as possible, discreetly prompting the player when necessary.

What do you think about tutorials? What is tolerable and what is annoying? Can you remember one you liked?

Even among the dead, cold [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2085080/announcements/detail/4192362393711606466]Snowy Peaks[/url] you can find an island of comfort. Here dwells a mysterious winged shaman who is trying to preserve the legacy of the lost folk of the harpies and save the fading world. Will she succeed? One thing's for sure: she certainly can't do it without the help of the Gunslinger....

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/0f00ed0f52b5fe696941fc4174b652528e6e4b8b.png[/img]

We are proud to showcase another Princess Hunter level inspired by the work of one of the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2085080/announcements/detail/3691301424425236362]Monster Girl Contest[/url] finalists, Wind Of Indigo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/348350dd9e177a16b1309fdef2d964948a164c5f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Announcing a New World!
notes.notes:
We hope, the "news" we posted on the April Fool's Day made you smile... and now we're completely serious!

Before this, we showed you the Wyrdwood, but as the Master wrote, “there are other worlds than these.” The Gunslinger will have to travel a lot across different worlds in search of princesses, and one day the road will lead him to cold lands known as the Snowy Peaks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/64d018b2a15aed47a9403f33c24a9f8ac081bb41.png[/img]

These mountains were once filled with magical crystals and magical ores, but the Crimson King pumped out the rocky depths. Since then, the Snowy Peaks have slowly faded away, and the emptied mountains have sunk. The harpies, who once ruled the peaks, have not been seen for a very long time, and without the Guardian Princess, any world is doomed.

notes.title: Devlog #6
notes.notes:
As you may have noticed, we now have a special icon for our Devlogs with a joke inside (you could say, it's practically a single-frame comic)! But we also have other things to share with you today.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/fc8be6e7cc6ac083406d7aa5aa47f4c383690fbc.png[/img]
[h1]30,000 wishlists[/h1]
Not too long ago, we celebrated a very important milestone—25,000 wishlists on Steam. And in the blink of an eye, we've passed the 30,000 mark! Our recent trailer has been added to YouTube recommendations, garnering over 100,000 views in just one week.
 
[previewyoutube=Q4HWsqDoTz0;full][/previewyoutube]
We've received a tremendous amount of super-motivating feedback, and now even more people are waiting for the release of Princess Hunter. Thank you all for your support and trust!
[h1]Keeper of the Cold Spring[/h1]
Those of you who follow our project on [url=https://www.reddit.com/user/An_Dant]Reddit[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/Princessshunter]X[/url], or elsewhere, know that we drew this character last year. But now he's actually in the game! 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/f2242c0f56aa52f6f0892608eb714c006a0d8554.jpg[/img]
Lota's age is anyone's guess, as are his real thoughts. Despite his youthful appearance, he remembers Wyrdwood long before the arrival of Crimson King's hordes. His smile is more than just cold—it is icy!
[h1]Level building[/h1]
Although Princess Hunter looks like a cartoon, it is not as flat as it may seem. Frankly speaking, what you see is actually somewhere between a traditional 2D image and a 3D scene. This is called 2.5D, and it allows for deeper levels and opens up a lot of new possibilities… but it also creates just as many problems when building a level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/211e5ee00c2457014dc5e40cdb2e037f0726dfbf.png[/img]
To make life easier for level designers, our programmer has created a level building toolkit. Each scene now has several separate depth layers where you can sort objects both manually and automatically. In addition, it is now more convenient to plot the character's path. And for more thorough testing, it is possible to change the time scale by either speeding it up or slowing it down.

notes.title: The new trailer is out!
notes.notes:
Early followers of Princess Hunter can remember the old trailer on the game's Steam page. It had been put together rather quickly using mainly assets rather than real gameplay footage. Although many liked the trailer, our team was unhappy with its quality—especially with the fact that it didn't reflect how beautiful the game is in motion. Therefore, driven by perfectionism, we've deleted that old video and started to work on a new one trying to make it as beautiful and real as possible.

[previewyoutube=Q4HWsqDoTz0;full][/previewyoutube]

Unwilling to compromise on quality, we've spent much more time than it was planned originally. And yet, the day has finally come when we can show you—with pride (and a bit of trepidation)—the new trailer for Princess Hunter, which is the result of joint efforts of many people. Hope you'll like it!

[previewyoutube=i2LYDsLHK4U;full][/previewyoutube]

As you progress through the game, new companions will join the Gunslinger by the campfire. The hero can spend the night chatting with them… or watching the stars together ;)

It's also a great excuse to tell you that we've started a YouTube channel! Subscribe, like, share... and, of course, enjoy the wonderful music and video. 

By the way, you can also find a 2-hour version of this video there!

notes.title: Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!
notes.notes:
2023 is nearly over. While we didn't achieve one of our main goals—that is, to release the Princess Hunter demo—we still managed to do as much as possible to make it happen. We've put a lot of effort into the game over these 12 months. Our team has been joined with an experienced and very cool programmer. We've hosted a monstergirl contest. Our artists have drawn a heap of great comic strips (if you still haven't seen any, they can be found on [url=https://twitter.com/Princessshunter]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.reddit.com/user/An_Dant]Reddit[/url], and [url=https://www.webtoons.com/en/creator/_kbgvd]Webtoon[/url]). A number of atmospheric soundtracks have been composed that you'll hear in the game. That's not counting new characters, dialogues, quests…

And in order to celebrate the upcoming holidays, we've prepared a New Year-themed art for all of you who are looking forward to our game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/adda262a813ba874c4aa8e19ec8b8d75880e4371.png[/img]

Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!

notes.title: Devlog #4
notes.notes:
It's been a while since our last news update, but not because there was nothing worth writing about. We've been busy preparing a build for our new trailer which we really want to share with you just before this year ends or soon after the new year begins!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/9436f103588c68f6cc7bc59b44c98f43cd16e604.png[/img]

We've set ourselves a task not to create just a video reel, but to include as much real-game footage as possible into it, so that you could see what the game really looks and plays like. Therefore, our main goal was to make the latest build both atmospheric and pleasing to the eye.

[h1]Reflections[/h1]

There are plenty of various pools in Wyrdwood—one location is even called the "Lake Valley"! Up until now they've been providing the lush greenery with water, but still looked too static and dull. Not anymore!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Wvx8bpw/Reflections2.gif[/img]

We proudly present revamped water to you, full of life, motion, and reflections! We've even written a special shader, and now water matches the style of other graphics in [b]Princess Hunter.[/b]  

[h1]Critters[/h1]

Surely, our plans to make the surroundings look more alive went beyond water. We decided to populate Wyrdwood not only with dangerous enemies and talkative NPCs, but with ordinary animals as well.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/kKf7Bg4/Critters.gif[/img]

Currently, the list of animals comprises several types of amphibians, some birds (including a cute-as-hell goatsucker), and a bunch of butterflies. These butterflies vary in color and even can follow pretty complicated flight paths.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/da62d585d223cf9645bbce6502865b41b4595d0d.jpg[/img]

We're planning to increase the biodiversity of forest life and even add some interactivity to it!

[h1]The Camp[/h1]

The campfire scene, however, took the most time. In static form, we made it a long time ago, but it still lacked an animated campfire and characters around it. Besides, we wanted to add real lighting.

This last task proved to be a tough one, since we were not satisfied with the quality of ready-made solutions for 2D scenes. That's why we had to experiment here, too, and write new shaders that would suit our needs. As has been mentioned above, it took us really much time, but the end result exceeded our expectations!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/jht6jf6/Camp2.gif[/img]

This illumination (all frames have been drawn by hand and have gone through many iterations) gave us the opportunity to see the camp in a completely new light ;) Add to this a gorgeous background music written specifically for this scene, and it would seem as if you really could feel the wavering warmth and smell the smoke.

notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.notes:
[h1]Achievement Unlocked[/h1]

A year ago, when launching a Steam page for our game, we couldn't even imagine that the story of a Gunslinger traveling with a group of monstergirls would generate such a following. And we're proud to announce that recently we've reached our target of 10,000 wishlists! What's more, we've even surpassed it; currently, more than 12,000 people are looking forward to Princess Hunter's release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/e99d05877c0ce05b7a6327855f785d79976ead3f.png[/img]

It goes without saying that we find these figures highly motivating, which makes us redouble our efforts. We're extremely grateful to all of you who've added our game to your wishlists, told your friends about it, and—especially—signed up for updates like this Devlog. Thank you very much for putting your faith in us!

[h1]A New Character[/h1]

The Multiverse is inhabited by all sorts of sentient beings. Some of them have witnessed events of eons ago, and some have literally just appeared before your own eyes. Like, for instance, this slightly confused but lovable and friendly kid.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/955a616ddf8096c54982a9c948372513a77c5097.png[/img]

Strictly speaking, it will depend on you, the player, whether the little A-Lot'l becomes a veritable magical spring Guardian and whether he appears at all in the first place!

[h1]First Things First[/h1]

Making a game is not just about implementing its mechanics, but also about building a set of tools to implement them efficiently. If the tools are handy, not only does it speed up the creation of a virtual world, it is also good for optimization, significantly reducing the number of bugs and facilitating the debugging process.

Specifically, our lead programmer has made a special Entry Level scene that initializes all in-game scripts in a given order. Before, all of this used to happen rather out of control, which introduced many unnecessary complications into the debugging process and could potentially become a game-breaker. Well, not anymore!

[h1]Traveling Between Levels[/h1]

And we've made progress in the game mechanics as well. In our previous devlog, we boasted that the Gunslinger can draw maps of places he'd visited—despite not being able to travel between them! Well, now he can do that too. The Gunslinger is no longer confined to a single location and may roam freely around Wyrdwood.

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.notes:
[h1]Maps[/h1]
In order not to get lost while exploring the game's many levels, the hero will diligently map his travels in his journal, complete with environmental sketches and notes. This is what it looks like:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/0f40a5f01df3b24a53d3a711d4ce01642e50eed7.png[/img]

Newly discovered clearings and important notes will be automatically added as the game progresses. To accomplish this, we've written a script that stores object states (soon we're going to use it for tweaking the quest system). While there is still much to be done concerning the maps, they are not placeholder pics anymore!

[h1]Also...[/h1]

Thanks to the script mentioned in the previous devlog, we now can change sprites on the map. For instance, when the Gunslinger finds a camp spot for the first time, it will look abandoned. But after spending at least one night there, it will have a tent and a small fire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/0472c3092e0134bbae8227bfb051c77dd437471b.png[/img]

We've also added a custom function into the Fungus plugin that is able to run any external interface—barter, smithing, or combat—right in the middle of a dialogue, thus giving us much more narrative freedom.

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.notes:
[h1]Introduction[/h1]
Making comics and running contests is good, but what about the game? To keep everyone, who is invested in our project, informed about the development process, we've decided to start this Devlog, a Princess Hunter-related diary of sorts. 

Recently, the proportion of Nikitas in the team has grown 30%. We were lucky; the new Nikita turned out to be a very cool programmer. Thanks to him, the development process will hopefully gain an increased momentum. But before diving into the project proper, one has to study it first. That's why we asked him to implement an auxiliary, but still very interesting task, namely…
[h1]NOTES[/h1]
All worlds of Princess Hunter are inhabited by book gnomes. They can't read, but they have a bizarre attraction to handwritten texts. Gnomes fanatically steal every piece of paper or parchment they find, hiding them like squirrels hide nuts. It can be a page from a diary, a treasure map, a love letter, or a scrap from the Necronomicon. Well, you know... gnomes!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/3FMggTx/Dev-Log1-6.gif[/img]

Now our hero can pick up those notes and store them in his Journal. Some notes can be flipped, revealing extra texts (and drawings) on the reverse side. We've made five different variations of the notes to give each scrap of paper a unique look.

Meanwhile, the other part of the team was busy trying to harness…
[h1]EMOTIONS[/h1]
Dialogues are an essential part of Princess Hunter, and we relentlessly work on improving all their aspects.

The dialogue system uses the Unity plugin called Fungus, but over the course of development we've made a lot of major custom additions to it. As a result, Fungus has added many new features… but lost some original ones (which was quite unexpected). One of them was swapping character sprites during a dialogue: if the Gunslinger offends one of his companions, for example.

We couldn't accept such a loss, and that's why we wrote our own implementation of said feature. Now, nothing would prevent Ingeborg from becoming angrier or even enraged!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/f142d10a2d2fdbf71bcdaa4a4bef289f81404f7c.png[/img]

notes.title: Monstergirl Contest: Voting Is Open!
notes.notes:
So, the contest is over. We’ve received more than 170 entries. Honestly, we haven’t expected such a fantastic participation!

The contest attracted a wide selection of professionals, from CGI and traditional artists to sculptors and animators. But all of them have something in common: they all are extremely talented and they all love what they are doing… and monstergirls, of course! :)

It took us much time to prepare everything for the voting process which officially starts with this announcement and [b]finishes in a week, on Tuesday, March 7, at 06:00 PM (UTC). The winners will be announced on Thursday, March 9.[/b]

We have accumulated, numbered, and uploaded all the entries to Google Drive.

[h2][url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qoxmeyrfc2im7lSAlPKRu86ulXnU6CXE?usp=share_link]You may see them here.[/url][/h2]

Since choosing the One among about 200 splendid entries would be a superhuman endeavor, [u][b]we have decided to let every voter choose five entries he or she liked the most.[/b][/u]

Yes, you’ve read that right! It’s five entries, not one, or four, or six… The order does not affect the final score, so don’t agonize over which girl has to be placed first. Each entry you vote for will get a full point. 

Voting is anonymous, but please keep in mind that you can vote only once!

[h2][url=https://forms.gle/pxLK8Z5MKtAt4L7y6]Vote for your favorites here.[/url][/h2]

Meanwhile, we will be calculating the results of the jury’s voting and looking forward to the organizer’s decision.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/cd82b540f8c1f0447b267ee5c1f825354fa0711d.png[/img]

Let’s find out which monstergirl out there is the best--together!

notes.title: Monstergirls contest!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/2c742b8d1b69753c2d694659c1fe53831f4ea4e8.png[/img]

We’re happy to announce a creative contest for anyone with vivid imagination, regardless of artistic skill! [b]In a nutshell:[/b]
[quote=author] [list]
[*] [h3]Invent your own unique monstergirl![/h3]

[*] [h3]Draw her[/h3], make a sketch, a model, a 3D-printed figurine, or put her together using bottle glass… Just do a visual representation of your monstergirl using any media and style you like!

[*] [h3]Post an image of your monstergirl on the Internet[/h3] and send it to: [url=cavemenprogrammerz@gmail.com]cavemenprogrammerz@gmail.com[/url]

[*] [h3]Try to do it within a month![/h3]
[/list] [/quote]
[h1]Will there be prizes, you ask? [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/71d1c29db4699cf3e30ce33380af296b5b589bf2.png[/img]
The first three winners will get a money prize and an opportunity to implement their monstergirls in our game!

[quote=author] [h2]1st place: $300[/h2]
 
[h2]2nd place: $200[/h2]

[h2]3rd place: $100[/h2]

[h3]Public vote winner: $50[/h3]
[h3]Secret category winner: $50[/h3] [/quote]
In addition, we will share the works across as many channels as possible, thus generating visibility and, possibly, a fan base for each contestant!

Below you can see the detailed rules explanation. Everyone wishing to take part in the contest is kindly advised to read it through carefully, so that any misunderstandings or mistakes can be avoided.
[h1]Rules[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/14267a9d9a0011f37e4cbe08279616eecde820b2.png[/img]
[h2]Main conditions[/h2]
[olist]
[*][b]The contest organizers reserve the right to disqualify any entry that fails to meet one or several of the conditions below.[/b]

[*][b]A monstergirl… What is it?[/b] In our interpretation, a monstergirl is any non-human female being, such as a lamia, a harpy, a cobold, etc., but also an elf, a goblin, a fairy, or any other fantasy creature. However, taking an human-like creature and changing its skin color or pasting some pointy ears onto it would be lame. We’re not going to censor such entries, but they are more likely to get less votes. However, try to steer clear of the other extremity: being a monster, your creature still has to have a girly appeal! Hybrids with objects, inanimate matter or elements are allowed, but within the setting boundaries (see below).

[list]
[*][url=https://mobile.twitter.com/bigmsaxon/status/1610809034671640578]A good monstergirl - OK![/url]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/RoninDude/status/1383169346239746049]Another monstergirl - A bit boring, but still OK![/url]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/Princessshunter/status/1536987877476814848]A monster, not a girl - Not OK![/url]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/Raichiyo33/status/1612184343497113608]A girl, not a monster - Not OK![/url][/list]
[*][b]Humanization should be avoided.[/b] Meaning that any animal/object-transformed-into-a-girl arts will not be accepted. An ordinary person wearing some exotic body paint, hair style, or clothing is NOT a monstergirl!

[list]
[*][url=https://mobile.twitter.com/_Fiship/status/1527053437413863424]Good humanization[/url]
[*][url=https://www.artstation.com/artwork/ArJG5N]Bad humanization[/url][/list]
[*][b]Furries are fair game.[/b] The boundary between monstergirls and furries is fuzzy at best, and we are not going to define it. If you wish to make your character more beast-like, you’re welcome! However, remember to keep her anthromorphic to some degree at least. Traditional talking ponies, female dragons and other beasts will not be accepted.

[list]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/Princessshunter/status/1609235137773948930]Good furry[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/kogotsuchidark/status/1422321803188477953]Bad furry[/url]
[/list]
[*][b]Any medium will do.[/b] Your entry may be 2D, 3D, a digital painting, a pencil sketch, a GIF image, a video reel, a comic strip, a figurine, a cutout, a mosaic made of nickels or dimes, etc… Your only limits are your imagination and skills. Idea trumps execution (see below).

[*][b]Idea trumps execution.[/b] We value high-quality entries, but idea and design are more important to us. Also, remember that there will be piblic voting.

[*][b]Your character has to be designed from scratch specifically for the contest.[/b] Entries that include fan arts with existing characters or original works conceived and executed before the contest will be disqualified.

[*][b]Fantasy or mythological settings only.[/b] We accept a wider interpretation of the fantasy genre, from classic high fantasy to steampunk. But no electronic gadgets, futuristic devices or aliens, please. Modern, sci-fi, cyberpunk, or retrofuturistic background details can be used for artistic purposes, but they can’t be a part of the character design. Anachronisms are allowed.

[list]
[*][url=https://www.deviantart.com/colbystevenson/art/Drider-545010024]OK[/url]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/shepherd_0821/status/1611469576491143168]Acceptable[/url]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/hou_jae04/status/1608419148379590656]This one, too[/url]
[*][url=https://www.furaffinity.net/view/49244965/]No-no-no![/url]
[/list]
[*][b]SFW only![/b] Mildly erotic entries are allowed, but they cannot contain depictions of full frontal nudity, bare breasts showing nipples, graphic images of female genitals or the like. However, a naked body partly covered with fur, feathers, scales, etc. is allowed. If in doubt, contact us to avoid misunderstandings.

[list]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/NoxxyVoxxy/status/1554108606743822343]Acceptable[/url]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/Huffslove/status/1598361284663132160]Borderline[/url]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/Huffslove/status/1581676348594159616]Definitely not![/url](18+!)
[/list]
[*][b]Nothing wrong with classics.[/b] You are free to use any existing mythological creatures: medusas, centaurs, harpies, ghosts, etc. However, try to add at least a little bit of originality so that your entry doesn’t look too trite, whatever the quality.

[*][b]Be original.[/b] We encourage you to be bold, creative, and original! Mother nature and human imagination provide endless possibilities for cool hybrids and unique designs!

[*][b]No politics, please.[/b] In these uncertain times, we feel a need to highlight this otherwise obvious point. Your entry must not contain any direct hints pointing at real events, nations, or symbols. However, we fully support adding national color or traditional motifs to your design.

[*][b]Be careful with religious motifs.[/b] Angels, demons, efreets, and even nuns (or other religious people) are allowed as long as it is still an original idea. Try to use abstract religious inspirations; reimagining apostles or Buddha as monstergirls is a bad idea.

[*][b]Only one entry from each participant.[/b] We do not prohibit contestants from producing more than one entry; however, only one of them will participate in the final vote--either the latest one or one specifically marked as the contest-ready by the author. The number of entries will not affect the results. However, if you have any new ideas beyond the original one, feel free to present them too! The more cool arts and monstergirls there are, the better!

[b]UPD: due to the abuse of this item we are forced to impose a restriction: each participant can make no more than three substitutions.[/b]

[*][b]AI-generated images will not be accepted.[/b] We do not prohibit using neural networks as a source of ideas or inspiration. However, AI-generated images lacking your personal touch will be disqualified. Unfortunately, there have been such precedents. So, in order to avoid misunderstandings, it would be wise to preserve a timelapse of your work or at least earlier variants and sketches so that you can provide them if the style and look of your entry raises suspicions.
[/olist]
[h2]Additional conditions[/h2]
[olist]
[*][b]You may provide a description for your monstergirl.[/b] The description is optional and should be concise (preferably up to 300 characters). It won’t have any influence on the results, but may happen to be a nice finishing stroke. Please don’t give a detailed biography of the character, or explain her anatomy and lifestyle. A name and an interesting fact will suffice. Remember, however, that text-only entries without pictures will not be accepted!

[*][b]Your monstergirl in Princess Hunter![/b] Winning entries may be implemented in our game. However, we cannot guarantee it, as even the most creative entry may be out of place in our project. Also, we will understand if the creator doesn’t want to share his/her creation with us--it’s completely normal! Your permission to use your character is not a precondition, and everything will be discussed individually after the results are announced.
[/olist]
[h1]Terms[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/fe603564f8b5ba55413a7ed26554460bf4066d3c.png[/img]
Entries will be collected over a month (30 days, starting from the day the contest is announced--January, 23). Therefore, the deadline is [h2]February, 22, 2023, 23:59 UTC.[/h2]
During this period, the contestants will have to publish their entries on any resource using the following hashtags:

[h1]#princesshuntergame #MonsterGirlContest [/h1]

If it's not against the website rules (in Instagram, for example, it is not permitted to post external links!), it'd be cool if you could add a link to this Steam thread, where the terms & conditions of the contest are described in full.

If you are present in any of the following social networks, we will be happy for shares and mentions:
[list]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/Princessshunter]Twitter[/url]
[*][url=https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100089192629379]Facebook[/url]
[*][url=https://www.instagram.com/cavemenprogrammerz/]Instagram[/url]
[*][url=https://www.reddit.com/user/An_Dant]Reddit[/url]
[*][url=https://vk.com/princess_hunter]VK[/url]
[/list]
In addition, the contestants are required to send links to their entries to: [url=cavemenprogrammerz@gmail.com]cavemenprogrammerz@gmail.com[/url], with the subject: MonsterGirl Contest. We will share your entry through our social media accounts and add it to the album of the contest.

Please note that for your entry to be accepted, both conditions have to be met. If you don’t have a public account on any of the resources, just email your entry to us along with the name, under which you would like to participate, and we will publish it in our social media accounts.
[h1]Voting[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647373/cd82b540f8c1f0447b267ee5c1f825354fa0711d.png[/img]
Each entry will get points from three independent sources [b](up to 10 points from each)[/b], to keep the results as unbiased as possible. The shortlist will be formed according to point totals.
[h2]Organizer[/h2]
Makes judgements based on his personal preferences.
[h2]Jury[/h2]
There will be a panel of about a dozen experts, who will rate the entries, and then the average will be calculated.
[h2]Public vote[/h2]
A number of platforms will be monitored. Everybody is kindly advised against cheating, such as mass voting or vote buying. Here we rely on the participants’ discretion, since we have almost no means to verify the validity of voting. Anyway, the stakes are not so high to justify risking your reputation. Let the most creative contestants win, not the most cunning!

If there are too many entries, voting will be conducted in several rounds.
